g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Banana contour remains a single dot row. Apple contour is sampled before stem to omit duplicate junction dots. Orange outer and core contours precede the six radial separators; duplicate contact dots omitted. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Banana and apple bodies and orange segment surfaces are lower grey; contours, apple stem and orange separators higher black. Orange core stays white unraised. No measured-height or material claim.
